Night shift handover log

Ward A summary

Fourteen patients settled by midnight. Bed four had a brief fever spike at twenty-three hundred and responded well to acetaminophen after forty minutes.

Bed nine is awaiting morning lab results before discharge sign-off. The family has been notified to arrive after ten o'clock once rounds finish.

Twelve patients resting quietly. Oxygen flow on bed twelve was reduced to two litres per minute at two thirty after steady saturation readings for four hours.

Pharmacy restocked the central cabinet at three fifteen. One outstanding order for intravenous potassium remains queued for the seven o'clock delivery.
